prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single universally “best” agency — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry, and the services you need. I can recommend agencies, but first it helps to know a few things so I can match you to the best fit.

Quick questions
- What are your primary goals? (lead gen, ecommerce sales, brand awareness, SEO, PPC, social, full-service)
- What’s your monthly/annual marketing budget?
- Are you B2B or B2C? Local-only or national/international?
- Do you already have a website and analytics set up?
- Any timeline or performance targets (e.g., X leads per month)?

How to pick the best St. Louis agency (short checklist)
- Relevant experience: case studies in your industry and with similar goals
- Measurable results: clear KPIs and examples of ROI, not just vanity metrics
- Services & team fit: in-house vs. outsourced, access to strategists and account leads
- Transparency: reporting cadence, clear pricing, contract terms
- References & retention: client testimonials and average client tenure
- Tools & certifications: Google Partners, Meta, marketing automation platforms you care about

Questions to ask any agency during vetting
- Can you show 2–3 relevant case studies and the specific, measurable outcomes?
- Who will be our day-to-day contact and who does the work?
- How do you measure success and how often do you report?
- What’s the expected timeline to see meaningful results?
- What are your fees and how are they structured (retainer, project, performance)?
- Can you provide references from current or recent clients?

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 3–5 St. Louis agencies tailored to your needs
- Draft an outreach email/RFP template you can send to agencies
- Walk through how to evaluate proposals and contracts

Tell me your goals and budget and I’ll suggest a short list of suitable St. Louis agencies.
